QuestInfo.name: Guardian of the Town
QuestInfo.0: #bBig Headward#k, in #bHenesys Ruins#k, is looking for some help.
QuestInfo.1:
Big Headward left the path of a stylist to protect the town. Help him by defeating the #r#o8600002##k monsters.

You can find them in #b#m271010300##k and #b#m271010301##k.
QuestInfo.2: You helped Big Headward protect the town by defeating the #r#o8600002##k monsters.

0.0: Hello. Sorry about earlier. I'm sure you understand that we've got to be very cautious towards strangers.

yes.0: Because of the Cygnus Knights, I've had to make a career change from stylist to soldier. I've even put on this ugly armor. It's so last season! I haven't even done my hair.
yes.1: I've made an effort, but there's still just as many monsters as there were before. Maybe I'm too slow about it. *sigh* Maybe I'm just not cut out for this. Heh. 'Cut' out.
yes.2: Please help defend the town! Eliminate #r100 #o8600002##k monsters in #b#m271010300##k or #b#m271010301##k.

no.0: I didn't mean to offend you.

0.1: Well, if you have what it takes to make it all this way, maybe you can give me a hand. It's just a little monster hunt. Nothing serious. You can say no if you want to.

1.0: Not done yet? We've all got to work together if we want to survive.

yes.0: Wow! I knew you were strong when you jumped right in to help, but THAT strong? Phew! I'm jealous. Wish I could fight like you. But I trained with scissors, not swords.

mob.0: Please help fight off the monsters threatening the town. Eiminate #r100 #o8600002##k monsters in #b#m271010300##k or #b#m271010301##k.
